chapter: Caravan, Perdido and the first tunes
title: How Perdido got its name
summary: Barney Bigard mentioned a street named Perdido; since it sounded Spanish for 'lost', Tizol used it.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Barney told me to call him, because I asked Barney about what's the place of the street where "Some kind of street called the sporting class live, and he said, 'Perdito', 'some kind of street named that."
I said, but that sounds like a Spanish word called 'perdito', which means lost. You know? So I said I'm going to call it 'lost' -- Perdito.
